application.title: Conditional Use Request for Assisted Living - Warfield Parcel B

conditions: The Applicant shall comply with all Federal, State, and local rules and regulations applicable to the licensing, establishment, operation, and maintenance of assisted living facilities.

The Applicant provides additional information regarding the number of deliveries, timing of deliveries, and the types of trucks being used in order to appropriately assess what impact these will have.

The Applicant shall strictly adhere to the Town's 'Warfield Commercial Center: New Construction Design Guidelines and Standards for Signs' (2017 edition) when addressing bulk regulations and site development rules.
